newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp says studies continue to expand the Saudi Yanbu Petrochemical Company.
- Eritrean foreign minister says his country does not rule out Yemeni military attack to control disputed Hanish island.
- Doctors end strike in Khartoum, demonstrations continue in Sudan.
- Syria to start linking power grid with Jordan and Turkey in 1997 as part of a proposed plan to link the three countries together with Egypt and Iraq.
